parameterization: theta=atan2(bindX,-bindZ), bindY, piecewise linear on original posterior material triangles; same triangle interpolation yields exact posed endpoints. No nearest-vertex shortcut.
limits: A line path is necessary only; does not certify a neighboring ribbon, full cloth collision, area preservation or natural appearance.
The section envelope conservatively encloses the exact bevel geometry. Original triangles are still checked for actual segment crossings.
Routes are minimal polygonal guides; corners require a smooth curve with remaining material slack before meshing.
Positive materialSlack means a possible length reserve, not proof a smooth 3D cloth patch exists. Negative slack under fixed endpoints is a boundary limitation, not user design impossibility.
No changed product, mesh target, simulation, render, or animation.
